authority: DA 276; DE's finding, filed as R-924
WHY_A_READING_CONSTRAINT_AND_NOT_A_GATE: no gate can close it. Abstention that is INFORMATIVE and abstention that is HONEST are the same shape in the artifact -- both produce a non-OK challenger and an Identity fallback. The defect is not detectable from the primary number, so it is carried as a constraint on how the number is READ, and carried forward to the receipt so it cannot be lost between now and the score.
THE_CONSTRAINT_VERBATIM: §6 scores the policy's Identity fallback wherever a challenger is non-OK, so a challenger that abstains EXACTLY where it would have been wrong still improves the primary statistic; §8's 95% native-coverage gate bounds but does not eliminate this, since selective abstention inside the 5% allowance still flatters.
THE_MECHANISM_IN_ONE_LINE: a challenger is rewarded for its own silence: it keeps the Identity score on every action it declines, so declining precisely the actions it would have got wrong raises its measured performance above its real performance.

1_verbatim_in_the_step_6_receipt.rule: the constraint above is reproduced VERBATIM in the step-6 receipt, BESIDE the primary number
1_verbatim_in_the_step_6_receipt.not: paraphrased, summarised, or referenced by declaration name
1_verbatim_in_the_step_6_receipt.why: a constraint that travels as a citation is a constraint a reader can skip

2_native_OK_intersection_ALONGSIDE_the_p.rule: the native-OK intersection score is reported ALONGSIDE the primary, NEVER INSTEAD OF IT
2_native_OK_intersection_ALONGSIDE_the_p.why: the primary alone hides the abstention advantage; the intersection alone discards the fallback behaviour the policy actually has. THE GAP BETWEEN THEM IS THE QUANTITY OF INTEREST, and it is only visible when both are printed.

field_shape.gap: primary - native_ok_intersection, COMPUTED in the receipt

3_coverage_and_fallback_counts_are_FIELD.rule: per-candidate native coverage and the count of fallback-scored actions are FIELDS in the receipt, not prose
3_coverage_and_fallback_counts_are_FIELD.why: prose cannot be compared across candidates or checked by an instrument. A number can. Rule 10: compute predicates, never print conclusions.

WHAT_SECTION_8s_GATE_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_D.does: bounds the abstention to at most 5% of actions
WHAT_SECTION_8s_GATE_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_D.does_NOT: eliminate the flattery. 5% of actions chosen ADVERSARIALLY is not 5% of the effect -- a candidate that abstains on its worst 5% moves its measured score by far more than 5%. The gate caps the QUANTITY of abstention and says nothing about its SELECTIVITY.
WHAT_SECTION_8s_GATE_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_D.so: native coverage >= 95% is necessary and not sufficient, and the receipt must show both

WHEN_THIS_BINDS.and_before_then: no fair-value score is evidence at all (§11), so this constraint binds the FIRST number that would be
